design: Remembered per project and per window, like the list's other preferences (`page/hooks.ts`), never on the Hub. The last document opened is a habit of one person in one window, not shared project state. A link or a navigation that names a document always wins; remembering only fills in the case where none is named. The board's remembered scope (slice board-by-spec) follows the same rule.

checked: SpecPage.tsx: with no document named, the effect resolves to the manifest home via resolveSelection(inventory, null, home)
page/hooks.ts: list preferences are already kept per project in localStorage, the pattern this follows
limits: Not driven; whether the rail's Spec link always arrives with no document named was read, not observed

problem: Operator, 2026-10-28 (vault note src-08aab5d8a1c5): "The operator keeps returning to it and seeing the main AgentWeave spec, when they just want to go back to the spec they were on." Cause, read on master: when the Spec page is reached with no document named, `SpecPage.tsx` (the effect at ~line 52) always resolves to the manifest home (`resolveSelection(inventory, null, list.specList?.home)`). Nothing records which document was open last.

requirements.statement: When the Spec page is reached with no document named, it opens the document the operator last had open on the Spec page in that project, including after the app is reloaded or restarted.
When the Spec page is reached with a document named (a link, the palette, a notification, back/forward), it opens that document, and that document becomes the one remembered.
Each project remembers its own last document; opening a document in one project never changes what another project's Spec page opens.

When the remembered document no longer exists (deleted, or renamed by a path no longer in the list), the Spec page opens what it opens today (the manifest home, then the first readable document), and forgets the stale one. An archived document that is still in the list is reopened.

in_scope: The Spec page reached with no document named, in each project
Falling back to today's behaviour when the remembered document no longer exists
non_goals: Remembering the scroll position or the open section inside the document
Remembering documents in the side panel's tabs (they already persist through panelTabsStore)
Sharing the remembered document across windows, machines or the Hub
Changing which document a link, the palette or a notification opens

summary: Opening the Spec page without naming a document opens the one the operator last had open in that project, not the AgentWeave manifest.
